text:
Source-assisted selected reading of F-1szi (Paris, BnF, NAL 2317, f. 6). The lines below were reread on the image by a research reader with Paris, BnF, Latin 3806, fols. 163v-165r, and Liverani's printed text (snippets) at hand. All other lines of the leaf rest on the image-only first reading; fol. 6r column a is not read continuously. (..) = expanded abbreviation; [..] = lost or not read; ? = uncertain; & = et-ligature.

Canvas 0, fol. 6r, https://openapi.bnf.fr/iiif/image/v3/ark:/12148/btv1b52513241j/f17/full/4620,/0/default.jpg, column b, native box 2250,2100,4527,4300
 9  Respicite coruos .; tale e(st) hac si di
10  cer& .; Si d(eu)s [tam] uilia uolatilia p(ro)cur
11  at .; Multo mag(is) homine(m) que(m) ad lau
12  dem & gl(ori)am nominis sui formauit fa
13  me p(er)ire non p(er)mitt& .; Unde & psal
14  mista dicit(ur)? .; Iunior fui & eni(m)
15  [senui ...] .; Quo pastu? [...] psal
16  mista [...]
17  [...] pascit me & nihil mihi? de[erit]?
18  [.] nonne uos ma[gis] pluris estis [illis]
19  pluris in oc loco non p(ro) numer[o] sed
20  p(ro) dignitate . ponitur ac si dicat?
21  & nonne uos meliores [es]tis .; Quis
22  aute(m) u(est)r(u)m cogitans potest adicere
23  ad statura(m) sua(m) cubitum unum . h(oc)
24  non adfirmando s(ed) abnegando? dix(it)
25  non solu(m) enim ad statura(m) sua(m) cubi
26  tu(m) unu(m) quis cogitando adicere pote(st)
27  s(ed) nec paru[um] aliquid . [...]
28  [...] Neq(ue) unu(m) capillu(m) albu(m) aut
29  nigrum quis facere ualet . quia
30  [cre]ator & formator omnium qui
    (lines 15-18, 20 and 24 are rubbed; "Quo pastu", "ac si dicat" and "abnegando" follow the source where the letters seen allow it; the first reading had "an etiam dicit" and "dubitando?")

Canvas 1, fol. 6v, https://openapi.bnf.fr/iiif/image/v3/ark:/12148/btv1b52513241j/f18/full/4620,/0/default.jpg, column b, native box 2060,1000,4389,2900
 1  [ru]beum ut rosa sic pu[rpureum ut] uiola .;
 2  sed q(uo)d terrenus salomon h[abere non]
 3  potuit . n(oste)r . salomon uidel[icet paci]
 4  ficus d(omi)n(u)s n(oste)r ih(esu)s xp(istu)s hab& ip(s)e . h eni(m)
 5  ab& lilium in uirginib(us) rosam in ma
 6  tirib(us) uiola(m) in confessorib(us) . Si aute(m)
 7  fenum agri q(uo)d hodie e(st) . & cras in cli
 8  banum mittitur d(eu)s sic uestit .; hic
 9  datur intellegi quia sup(er)ius lilia
10  agri p(ro) omnib(us) herb(is) terre posuit .;
11  Ac si diceret si d(eu)s erb(as) terre q(ue) [su]bito
12  crescunt . & subito exares[cunt ...]
13  soll&? & siccantur sic uestit . [...]
    (holes in the parchment account for the bracketed words in lines 1-3 and 11-13)
